en.headline: Woman, 47, dies after collapsing at Tai Tong village house
en.dek: A woman was found collapsed at a village house on Kiu Hing Road in the early hours and was later certified dead at Pok Oi Hospital.
body: Police said they received a report at about 2am on Wednesday that a 47-year-old woman had collapsed at a village house on Kiu Hing Road in Tai Tong Village, Yuen Long. Local media reports said her husband made the call.
Ambulance crews found her unconscious and took her to Pok Oi Hospital, where she was later certified dead. Police said the cause of death had not been established and would depend on an autopsy.
Officers were treating the case as a sudden death while the post-mortem result was pending. No further details of the circumstances inside the house had been released by Wednesday morning.

zh.headline: 元朗大棠村47歲女子住所暈倒 送院後不治
zh.dek: 警方接報指一名女子凌晨在僑興路村屋暈倒，送往博愛醫院後證實死亡，死因有待驗屍確定。
body: 警方表示，周三凌晨約2時接獲報案，一名47歲女子在元朗僑興路大棠村一村屋內懷疑暈倒。本地傳媒引述警方消息稱，報案人是她的丈夫。
救援人員到場時女事主昏迷，把她送往博愛醫院搶救，其後證實死亡。警方稱死因有待驗屍後確定。
案件暫列猝死跟進。截至周三清晨，當局未有公布屋內情況的進一步細節。
